note.en: This is not the family’s first API launch or a weights release. 2026-08-16 at 16:00 UTC is a pricing-effective time, not this event date. deepseek-v4-pro is an alias, not a pinned checkpoint; current routing was not tested and regional eligibility/costs need separate checks.

note.en: Historical-status warning: the 2026-09-10 official log announced retirement of original V4 Flash / Vision Exp and temporary routing of old aliases to V4.1 Flash (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates/).
